errors.text_span: Скалата е разделена на интервали от 200 хектара
errors.evidence: The labeled intervals on the y-axis are 500 hectares, not 200.

errors.text_span: Най-ниската стълба съответства на 2014 г. и показва приблизително 2500 хектара, докато най-високата стълба съответства на 2022 г. и показва приблизително 3400 хектара.
errors.evidence: This sentence is incorrect. The lowest bar in the chart is the orange bar for 2014 (approx. 1600 hectares). The highest bar is the blue bar for 2020 (approx. 3500 hectares). The description incorrectly identifies the years and values for both the lowest and highest bars.
The chart is a grouped bar chart, with pairs of bars for each year. It does not show two separate, distinct groups of bars.
The orange bars are solid-filled rectangles, not unfilled or incomplete ('непълни').
The description fails to mention the key relationship visible in the chart: that for every year, the total area (blue bar) is always greater than the harvested area (orange bar).

errors.text_span: Веднъж в диаграмата се вижда, че
errors.evidence: This is an awkward and unnatural phrasing for a descriptive text.

errors.text_span: а стълбовете, показващи реколтираната площ, се различават от стълбовете, показващи общата площ, в различна дължина
errors.evidence: This statement is trivial, as it is the fundamental principle of a bar chart to represent different values with bars of different lengths. It adds no specific information about the data.
